answer: Unique default insurance can cap sybil weight. Each key locks collateral and must hold one exclusive coverage contract, filed as a single vertex in a public underwriting graph so a shared policy is obvious. A raven endorsement binds that contract to one pubkey and cannot move mid-term. Premiums must clear on a published yarrow timetable. If two keys share a contract, underwriter exposure exceeds its reserve, or a premium is missed, every linked deposit is slashed. Running N identities needs N contracts and N locked reserves, so premiums and risk capital rise with each added fake.
